works.title: UI animations made with Opus 5.5 and Clayzo
works.format: 1080x1080, 25 s, 2x2 grid then each panel solo
works.made_with: Hand-coded SVG/CSS components, screen-recorded with a cursor; no image or video model (his reply: 'These are real UI components')
works.observed: One dark navy outline at one weight; flat fill plus one shade band plus one white highlight streak; halftone dots on the shadow side; soft ellipse ground shadow; one pastel background per panel; 4-point sparkle stars; spring motion with squash and stretch and shape morphs.
works.ours: Built as mv-projects/indieagent-clean-vector-test (ticket stub stamped BOOKED), rheos/secondunit-videos PR #232. Robin: 'the look lands'.

works.title: Orb and portals
works.format: 16:9, 28 s, with sound; Python + Blender, flat toon shading with paper grain
works.observed: A blue orb stays dead centre for the whole film. Sound arrives as ripple arcs; a ring around the orb opens as a circle portal onto a place that makes a sound (pond, cricket, jellyfish, owl, frogs, radio, whale, storm, koi, bicycle bell, wind chimes), about 1.4 s each. After about 16 s every place returns as a mosaic of circles. A pink orb arrives; they orbit on a tilted ground; the frame fills with pairs; ends on 'opus 5.5 / claude'.
works.ours: Compare blender-orb-visualizer take 01: same premise, abstract scenes; his anchors every cut on the orb and makes the scenes concrete.

works.title: Honey bee film (prompt shared)

works.title: A paper boat goes on a journey
works.url: subscriber post (x.com/kevin_t_ngo/subs); study only, never republish
works.observed: A black cat's paper boat with a goldfish leaves a canal windowsill, passes about 15 places (canal bridge, windmill polder with heron, cliff waterfall, jungle, lantern festival, storm, waterspout, moonlit clouds, dawn town) and comes home to the sleeping cat. Flat shapes with grain, water reflections everywhere, one day-to-night-to-dawn colour arc.
works.ours: The journey-home structure is Travel Agent's premise.

works.title: An outage told with objects

Felt-marker outlines with scribble-hatched colour; each object sketched in pencil first, then inked and coloured.

works.title: Loop GIFs, Jul-Oct 2026 (15 surveyed 2026-10-19)
works.observed: Loop mechanisms: symmetry turn (tesseract); Droste zoom (robot arm, Clawd at a desk); tunnel of self-similar rings (pixel invaders); impossible geometry (K09); conveyor of identical objects moving one spacing (marble machine, paper chain); self-resetting machine (Rube Goldberg, cuckoo clock); maker becomes the made; exit one edge, enter the other; build then unbuild (pixel heart, peekaboo kids); periodic noise field (crayon dabs). Looks: pixel voxel, toy diorama with depth of field, clockwork wood and brass, ink and marker comic, graphite on cream, coloured pencil on a photographed notebook.

works.title: Unofficial Tesla Roadster commercial, with 'How this was made'
works.observed: His process reply (status 2111887587317305477): Blender + Cycles every shot; the car modelled from photos and checked edge by edge from the same camera angles; the garage placed by Python scripts; Poly Haven and ambientCG CC0 assets; Mantaflow smoke; procedural volumes in code; ElevenLabs narrator and SFX plus some synthesized in code; score composed note by note in code on CC0 orchestra samples (VSCO 2, VCSL); edit, film look (bloom, halation, grain) and subtitles in Python frame by frame.

works.title: Unofficial Apple HomeView commercial, with 'How this was made'
works.observed: His process reply (status 2110730812014592434): Blender; every screen a web page captured frame by frame in Chrome and mapped onto 3D glass; Midjourney stills and image-to-video for a few shots; NASA photos; Depth Anything V2 for a depth map; ElevenLabs voices; a public-domain tune composed in code on VSCO 2 / VCSL. The one film in this list that uses generated images.

works.title: Code mirrors
works.url: github mirrors: qq89987112/slow-square, qq89987112/tapioca-animation, aaronvg/figure-sheet, aaronvg/math_class, bimohxh/cyber-crowd (his kengocodes account is gone)
works.observed: One HTML file, Canvas 2D, no libraries; mulberry32 seeded RNG per subsystem; lines drawn as filled ribbons with sine-sum wobble and pressure; paper rendered once per seed; slow-square is a pure function of t (window.SLOW.draw(t)); he scores 40 seeds and keeps the best.

works.title: Animation over a Dessa demo conversation
works.format: 1920x1080, 30 fps, 2:17.6, with sound (Block's published Dessa demo audio)
works.observed: A drawn video-call window: two tiles, name pills, speaking indicator, live captions with speaker labels, toolbar. Flat-vector characters with heavy black outlines on outline-free flat rooms (warm for the person, cool for the AI); mouths cycle with the voice; black mitt hands appear only for gestures. Static two-up for up to 42 s, four 2-3 s punch-ins (three on the listener), one push-in and one truck across the tiles, end card naming both speakers. Study: STUDY-video-call.md (V01-V08).

works.title: Bend explainer, every frame drawn by a renderer written in Bend
works.observed: One illustrated panel per beat on cream paper with a single caption line under it (16 beats in 2 min). Flat editorial illustration: code files as stacked paper towers, a law on graph paper, a fail screen in red, a benchmark bar chart, a GPU core grid. Arc: the habit (you won't read it all), the fix (a law), the fail case, the numbers, the payoff. Claude wrote a renderer in the language being explained.
works.ours: The format devweb episodes want (open on the habit, the bug is the proof). Not built.

works.title: Starship booster catch, a scrolling three.js statechart
works.observed: Paper theatre in three.js: rolled-paper rockets, balsa tower, cotton steam, tissue flames, torn-paper dunes, pastel sky; each state hangs as a felt patch, steps stitched as gold cord; ends with the chart embroidered on linen. Textures drawn with the statechart-art pencil and pastel kit. A Node test replays the flight and checks every solid against every other at 1000+ moments.
works.ours: The contact test is the idea worth taking for code-drawn 3D (see check-draw-order-before-geometry). Not built.
